svg.title: Architecture today
svg.desc: Two hosts serve the same repository. crystalina.org is static GitHub Pages, so the /api folder never runs there; the Vercel project runs the functions but has no environment variables set, so every server path returns 500. Verified 2026-08-31.

g.text: No server, so /api is dead here
